name: Kyuukatsu o Josou Suru
source: Takumi was used to have a great friend and he kept that relation in high esteem after they separated. What a surprise he had when they met again and discovered his best friend became a crossdressing slut!
translation: Takumi was used to have a great friend and he kept that relation in high esteem after they separated. What a surprise he had when they met again and discovered his best friend became a crossdressing slut!
